event_summary: The camera tilts and pans from a sky-and-tower view to a wider outdoor pool-and-slide area, with no visible independent scene-object motion.
raw_event_description: At the start, the frame shows blue sky and part of a tall gray stair tower on the right. The camera framing moves downward and slightly across the scene, bringing treetops, a grassy field, a fenced pool area, light-colored slides, and a red car into view. After the wider view is established, the framing becomes mostly steady. The visible scene objects remain in place and intact throughout.

reasons: The first frame shows only sky and a partial view of the tall stair tower.
The pool, slides, fence, car, trees, and ground area are not yet fully visible.
